method.baseline: Trailing 12-month average of New Building filings.
method.threshold: ±25% deviation from baseline flags a regime shift.
method.note: All figures are computed facts from primary DOB filings. Causal interpretation requires review.

narration.headline: New Building filings in Manhattan rose to 109 in July 2026 — +58% year-over-year (vs. 69 a year earlier). Signal: Elevated.
narration.citySummary: Citywide, 1,536 New Building filings were logged in July 2026 (74,535 proposed dwelling units), +15% vs. the trailing-12-month average and +24% year-over-year.
